UnitX is an AI-powered machine vision company that automates repetitive visual inspection tasks across factories worldwide. With over 1,000 systems deployed across 190+ global customers, UnitX machines continuously operate for more than 5.7 million hours globally, transforming quality control and driving measurable impact across industries.
Website by Amplify Industrial Marketing + Guidance.

UnitX is a robotics company developing AI-powered vision systems for quality and yield management in manufacturing. Its software-defined vision system OptiX and edge AI compute platform CorteX enable advanced defect detection, reducing scrap, improving yield, and upholding quality standards beyond human or legacy machine vision capabilities.

On September 27, 2023, UnitX raised $5 million from SE Ventures, a Silicon Valley venture fund backed by Schneider Electric. SE Ventures led the investment to support UnitX's geographic expansion and mission to enhance manufacturing quality, traceability, and profitability, particularly in electric vehicle and lithium-ion battery sectors.

UnitX's systems operate on production lines of top lithium battery and automotive manufacturers. CEO Keven Wang described UnitX as one of the fastest-growing players in its category, while SE Ventures' Varun Jain highlighted its product-market fit for delivering ROI to enterprise customers in expanding markets.

Total funding raised across rounds is reported as $69.6M in later stage VC, with prior figures like $12M up to September 2021 and $28.7M for another entity. UnitX focuses on production lines of top global manufacturers, with SE Ventures highlighting its superior product-market fit.

Relativity Space is a Long Beach-headquartered aerospace manufacturer pioneering 3D-printed rockets. Founded in 2015, it builds Terran 1 and Terran R vehicles using additive manufacturing, AI, and robotics for a supply chain with 100 times fewer parts. The company assembles rockets in under 60 days at its Florida launch site for satellite constellation missions.
